name: project-terrarium
description: Project maintenance for software delivery engagements. Build an Appian-ready ERD from meeting transcripts in SharePoint, project context MD files, and SharePoint docs, have an Appian architect review it for structural risk, and incrementally maintain it from new meetings and slide decks through reviewable change sets. Render the ERD as an interactive HTML diagram. Iterate on the ERD with an assistant that applies requested changes and keeps a binding Technical Decisions log. Sync the ERD with a living Lucidchart document: push it to Lucid and pull team edits back as a reviewable change set.
